questions.question: Which statement best describes the boundary of AutoML?
options: It discovers the correct business target from any table
It searches a declared pipeline space under a budget and evaluation protocol
It guarantees the selected model is production-ready
It removes the need for domain review
questions.explanation: AutoML automates candidate construction and comparison inside constraints supplied by people; it does not define the product decision or approve a release.

questions.question: A run has 80 search minutes, 2 workers, a measured 4-minute fit, and 5 validation folds. How many complete candidates fit under the lab's idealized arithmetic?
questions.explanation: The budget provides 160 worker-minutes, or 40 fit slots. Five fits per candidate allow 8 complete candidates.

questions.question: Why does the budget lab refuse to predict accuracy from rows, columns, and runtime?
options: Accuracy is always 100% after enough trials
Those inputs do not determine label quality, signal, split validity, algorithm behavior, or generalization
AutoML tools never report metrics
Runtime has no relationship to search capacity
questions.explanation: Dataset dimensions and time alone are insufficient to infer model quality. Accuracy must be measured under a valid evaluation design.

questions.question: Monthly observations from one customer can appear many times. Which validation boundary tests generalization to unseen customers?
options: Randomly shuffle all rows
Fit preprocessing on the full dataset first
Keep each customer's rows in one fold with grouped validation
Select the pipeline using the final test set
questions.explanation: Grouped validation prevents the same customer identity from appearing in both training and validation for a fold.

questions.question: What happens after a team changes its feature set because of a final test-set result?
options: The test set remains untouched because no weights were fitted on it
The test set has influenced selection and is no longer independent final evidence
The change is harmless if AutoML chose the feature
Nested validation is no longer needed
questions.explanation: Any test result that guides a modeling decision makes that test set part of the selection loop.

questions.question: What should happen immediately after an AutoML search selects its leading pipeline?
options: Promote it directly because it won validation
Publish only its best metric
Freeze the candidate and protocol, evaluate untouched evidence, verify operational constraints, and apply a release gate
Delete the losing candidate history
questions.explanation: Selection creates a candidate. Final evidence, reproducibility, serving checks, policy, ownership, rollout, and rollback determine release readiness.
